Sayuri Hara (Japanese: 原紗友里 Hara Sayuri) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Hara was born on November 5, 1988, in , , and she became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with . Hara became involved with the during , voicing Team Flare scientist Mable as well as Lilia, a girl who briefly proposed to .
